[head=2][color=#e8b04b]Count Olywir and the Collapse[/color][/head]
Sector Crescent was governed as a feudal territory granted to [bold]Count Olywir[/bold] by the Kaiser, in exchange for military loyalty and continued resource production. When the rebellions spread across the outer systems, Imperial control deteriorated slowly and painfully.
World after world fell into unrest. Supply lines fractured. Military garrisons were overthrown and raided.
The Kaiser expected Olywir to restore order. He failed.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]The Gate Closes[/color][/head]
As losses mounted, the Kaiser ultimately deemed the sector no longer worth the cost of reclamation. Rather than continue bleeding resources into a failing frontier, the Kaiser severed Sector Crescent from the wider Domain.
The gate to the outer universe was closed. Sector Crescent was abandoned.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]What Remains[/color][/head]
Everyone left in the sector was left with it. The Imperial forces that stayed behind, the unions that rose against Olywir's quotas, the corporations cut off from their markets, and the crews who never had a flag to begin with are all sealed in together, fighting over what the Kaiser threw away.
That war is where you come in. See the [color=#e8b04b]Factions[/color] page for who is still standing.
